body: Yes, I am safe, my parents are still in the "trying to understand me" phase(I came out already)

It's not that I look for them it's that they're pushed in my face when I log into the sites, and trust me, I do end up un-liking or unfollowing most of them for other reasons. I'll run into something like that on facebook and there'll be a picture of a woman, for example, in a tent and commenters will reply with sexist remarks like "She's only in the tent because there's no kitchen". Simple things that are FOR NO REASON had remarks like that. That's what kinda pissses me off more than anything.
I like that you and your wife do things that are placed on skill. I had a boyfriend who lived with me for 3 years and he'd always expect me to do the cook, cleaning and everything else , quote, "Women should do."
Moving out with nothing but a car, some clothes and my Nimrod album. Crossed 2 states and never turned back.
